primary: support iff last closed 1h close > level
reason: the 1h close is the decision grid itself (no stale role up to 4 h); a 4h close flips later
half an ATR keeps 'at the level' tighter than one 4h bar's typical range

primary: close rule: current close past the prior daily open
alternative: touch rule: the partial day's extreme past the prior open
reason: the operator says 'has moved past the opening' at a decision; a close is the PIT reading a trader quotes
2.5 % is about one DEV median daily range; 1.5 % pushes most days to the 12h/8h rungs

primary: band walk down in progress (3+ closes beyond, bandwidth expanding)
reason: the operator's 'dance' is the walk, not a single close outside
A is what a trader reads off swing highs/lows (markup = HH&HL); B is the repo's trend_tag reused

alternative: last 12 1h closes inside the prior 12 bars' range
reason: range-vs-ATR is one number a trader checks; the inside-range rule needs two windows

primary: last closed bucket (includes a candle completing at t)
alternative: cur_k - 1 (skips a candle completing at t)
reason: the fill at open[t+1] lies in the next bucket; a candle closed at t is closed information (same as BB/ATR)
